headline: Almaty Friday: Tsitsipas beats Duckworth, Bublik edges Khachanov
whyCareReason: Tsitsipas dispatched Duckworth 6-3, 6-4 to reach the semifinals. Bublik outlasted Khachanov in two tiebreaks.
teaser: Tsitsipas d. Duckworth 6-3, 6-4. Bublik d. Khachanov 4-6, 7-6(5), 7-6(5). Medvedev advances to semis.
story: The quarterfinals at the Almaty Open on Friday, 23 October, established the tournament's final four. Seventh-seeded Stefanos Tsitsipas continued his imperious indoor form, defeating Australia's James Duckworth 6-3, 6-4 in one hour and 22 minutes to claim a semifinal berth. Tsitsipas conceded only nine points on his first serve and broke Duckworth once in each set. In a thrilling three-set clash, third seed Alexander Bublik rallied past fifth seed Karen Khachanov 4-6, 7-6(5), 7-6(5), setting up a blockbuster Saturday semifinal against Tsitsipas. Top seed Daniil Medvedev also progressed with a 6-4, 6-4 victory over Terence Atmane, while Nikoloz Basilashvili defeated Adrian Mannarino 6-3, 6-1.
stakes: Tsitsipas meets crowd favorite Bublik in Saturday's headline semifinal. Medvedev faces Basilashvili.
rivalryAngle: Tsitsipas and Bublik set up an explosive contrast of styles in Saturday's semifinal.
funFacts: Tsitsipas defeated Duckworth 6-3, 6-4 without dropping serve.
Bublik saved multiple break points to edge Khachanov 4-6, 7-6(5), 7-6(5).
Semifinals set: Tsitsipas vs Bublik, Medvedev vs Basilashvili.
